name: azadbilik
title: Azad Bilik open data
description: Culture: the catalogue of the Kitabxana.az library of Azerbaijani literature (authors, books, works, translations, places) and the Azad Bilik gallery's index of miniatures by scene and chapter. Atlas: census populations of historical Azerbaijan by district and county, Azerbaijani communities in Georgia, Dagestan and Soviet Armenia, the peoples of Azerbaijan by district, native languages at the 1897 census, and the raions of the Azerbaijan SSR at the 1939, 1979 and 1989 censuses.

sources.title: State Statistical Committee of the Republic of Azerbaijan
Statistical Centre of Iran, via the Iran Data Portal
First General Census of the Russian Empire, 1897, Table XIII, via Demoscope Weekly

resources.name: languages-1897
resources.description: The 1897 census of the Russian Empire, Table XIII (native language): every language named in each governorate, uezd and town of the Baku, Elisabethpol and Erivan governorates, the Dagestan and Kars oblasts, and the Borchali uezd and Zaqatala okrug, by sex, as Demoscope Weekly transcribes it. Azerbaijani is the census's «татарский»: see NOTES.md. 1,277 rows.

resources.name: soviet-raions
resources.description: Azerbaijan SSR: population of each raion and city council at the all-Union censuses of 1939, 1979 and 1989, as each census drew them, with the districts of today that cover each one's land. Present population, total and urban, from Demoscope Weekly's tables; each year adds up to the republic's total. The 1939 raions differ from those of 1979–1989: see NOTES.md for how units were matched. 213 rows.

fields.name: soviet_unit
fields.description: Identifier within its census, e.g. divichi, kasum-ismailov, konakhkend; the page azadbilik.org/atlas/rayonlar takes it as ?r= (with ?y=1939 for 1939).

fields.name: census_rows
fields.description: The census rows summed for it, as printed; "=" starts from an aggregate and "-" takes a row off it (Stepanakert 1979); a name ending in * takes every row it begins (the 1939 Baku city council's districts). Several values are separated by ";".

fields.name: today_districts
fields.description: The districts of today it is drawn with, as geoBoundaries AZE ADM2 names them (as in census-az.csv); a merged pair shares its partner's. Several values are separated by ";".

fields.name: fit
fields.description: same: today's districts cover its land closely; approx: the land moved a little since (NOTES.md says how).

fields.name: drawn_with
fields.description: For raions merged since and drawn as one shape (e.g. Mir-Bashir + Mardakert, Martuni + Hadrut; in 1939 also Julfa + Abrakunis, Kuba + Konakhkend, Salyany + Khilli): the other one.
